change_summary: Added maxnreg=64 to all 19 triton.Config entries in the linear_bias_relu_kernel @triton.autotune decorator to cap PTX register allocation at 64 registers/thread (down from 96), reducing per-block register consumption and giving the compiler more scheduling freedom to increase active warps and hide latency.
